permission.plugin_locker24_health_access: View fleet health and alerts (Locker24 MDM)
plugin.locker24-health.fleet.title: Fleet health
plugin.locker24-health.fleet.help: Every tablet reports its health every 5 minutes. This page refreshes every minute. Click a tablet to see its history.
plugin.locker24-health.fleet.caption: Fleet health, {{count}} tablets
plugin.locker24-health.fleet.truncated: The fleet is larger than one page can show. Only the first 5000 tablets are listed.
plugin.locker24-health.filter.status.hel: Kiosk off (admin) is listed separately from Warning: it means an administrator left the kiosk on purpose. It never raises an alert.
plugin.locker24-health.filter.search.hel: Matches the tablet number, description, locker and groups.
plugin.locker24-health.reason.offline: Offline: no report for more than 10 min
plugin.locker24-health.reason.kiosk_vers: Kiosk app version differs from the configuration
plugin.locker24-health.column.status.hel: OK: all checks pass. Warning: battery below 20 %, not charging, above 45 °C, under 1 GB free or a kiosk version mismatch. Problem: offline for 10 min, kiosk not running, battery below 10 % or above 50 °C. Kiosk off (admin): an administrator exited the kiosk; no alert. No data: the tablet has not reported yet.
plugin.locker24-health.column.number.hel: Device number in the panel. Open it to see battery, temperature and Wi-Fi history.
plugin.locker24-health.column.configurat: The configuration (tenant) the tablet belongs to.
plugin.locker24-health.column.groups.hel: Device groups the tablet is in.
plugin.locker24-health.column.locker.hel: Short UID of the locker the kiosk app is paired with, as reported by the kiosk app.
plugin.locker24-health.column.lastSeen.h: When the server last received a report from the tablet, by the server clock. Hover for the exact time.
plugin.locker24-health.column.battery.he: Battery level from the latest report. The lightning icon means charging; the crossed plug means not charging, which is a warning because tablets must always be on power.
plugin.locker24-health.column.temperatur: Battery temperature. Above 45 °C is a warning, above 50 °C a problem.
plugin.locker24-health.column.kioskAppVe: Installed version of the locker kiosk app.
plugin.locker24-health.column.agentVersi: Version of the Locker24 MDM agent on the tablet.
plugin.locker24-health.column.kioskState: Whether the kiosk app is in the foreground as required.
plugin.locker24-health.device.title: Tablet
plugin.locker24-health.device.not_in_fle: This tablet has no current fleet entry.
plugin.locker24-health.device.truncated: Not all history could be loaded for this range. The chart shows what was loaded.
plugin.locker24-health.range.label: Time range
plugin.locker24-health.range.help: Long ranges are split into at most 1000 intervals; each point shows the worst value of its interval (lowest battery and signal, highest temperature).
plugin.locker24-health.chart.legend: Shaded: tablet offline (no report for more than 10 min). Dashed lines: warning and problem thresholds.
Battery level. Dashed lines at 20 % (warning) and 10 % (problem).
plugin.locker24-health.chart.temperature: Battery temperature. Dashed lines at 45 °C (warning) and 50 °C (problem).
plugin.locker24-health.chart.rssiDbm.hel: Wi-Fi signal strength. Closer to 0 is better; below -80 dBm the connection is weak.
plugin.locker24-health.offline.title: Offline periods
plugin.locker24-health.offline.help: Stretches longer than 10 minutes in which the server received no report from the tablet.
plugin.locker24-health.offline.none: No offline periods in this range.
plugin.locker24-health.settings.title: Fleet health settings
plugin.locker24-health.settings.read_onl: Read-only: changing these settings needs the Settings permission.
plugin.locker24-health.settings.time_zon: Used for times in alerts and on these pages, and for the kiosk update window.
Optional. Alerts are always shown in the panel; with a webhook they are also posted to this https address. The address is never shown again after saving, because it may contain a token.
The webhook will be removed when you save.
plugin.locker24-health.error.validation: The server rejected the value. Check the time zone and that the webhook is a public https URL.
plugin.locker24-health.error.permission: Not found, or you have no access to it.
plugin.locker24-health.error.server: The server could not complete the request.
plugin.locker24-health.error.network: Could not reach the server. Showing the last loaded data.
